key.name: auto-hide-indicator
key.description: Hide the top bar system tray button completely when no matching background apps are running.

key.name: show-count-badge
key.description: Display the number of background running applications next to the top bar icon.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which side of the GNOME top bar to place the indicator on.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Order index inside the selected top bar area.

key.name: visibility-mode
key.description: Choose whether to show only windowless background apps, include minimized apps, or show all running desktop apps.

key.name: default-visibility-mode
key.description: Preferred view mode to always use when opening the popup if Always Use Default Mode is enabled.

key.name: always-use-default-mode
key.description: Reset the popup to the preferred mode every time it opens, and use it for top bar filtering.

key.name: show-process-count
key.summary: Show process count and source tag
key.description: Display subtle metadata such as Packaging type (Flatpak/Native/Custom) and child process count in each app row.

key.name: enable-sni-watcher
key.description: Allow apps like Telegram, OBS, Motrix, and ZapZap to register native tray actions and menus.

key.name: enable-portal-monitor
key.description: Cross-verify sandboxed Flatpak background applications using org.freedesktop.background.Monitor.

key.name: force-quit-mode
key.description: Immediate sends SIGKILL to the entire app cgroup/process tree right away; escalate sends SIGTERM first and SIGKILL after grace period.

key.name: force-quit-grace-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to wait after SIGTERM before sending SIGKILL when force-quit-mode is set to escalate.

key.name: confirm-force-quit
key.description: Require a second confirmation click inside the app row before executing Force Quit.

key.name: custom-watched-apps
key.description: JSON entries defining custom user-added apps (executable path, AppImage, desktop ID, or process keyword) to track even without SNI or app.slice.

key.name: ignored-app-ids
key.description: List of canonical app IDs hidden from the system tray popup.

key.name: pinned-app-ids
key.description: List of canonical app IDs pinned to the top of the popup list.
